# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Confirmed the checked-out substrate/root-zone implementation already contained the restored rooted-plant O2-demand baseline, the corrected denitrification comment, and the habitat-registry reuse helpers; the remaining code change in this pass was updating `Engine::from_parts` to refresh `state.habitat_registry` before calling `step_substrate_zones`, so initialization now feeds the hot-path registry-reuse path with current habitat data and then refreshes again after the new penetration depth is applied.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the pending root-zone oxygenation amendments against the current substrate, engine, and integration-test code to determine which fixes were still missing in the checked-out branch.
2. [Completed] Patch `Engine::from_parts` so it refreshes the habitat registry before initialization-time substrate-zone normalization, aligning engine startup with the substrate hot path's registry-reuse assumption while preserving the already-present root-demand and comment fixes.
3. [Completed] Run formatting plus targeted and full-package `tank_core` validation to verify the substrate/root-zone behavior, initialization path, and lint state after the engine change.

## Validation Evidence

- Source inspection confirmed `crates/tank_core/src/systems/substrate.rs` already reuses a passed-in habitat registry in the hot path and restores rooted-biomass demand inside `estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate(...)`, and `crates/tank_core/tests/root_zone_oxygenation.rs` already carries the corrected denitrification comment.
- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib systems::substrate::tests -- --nocapture` passed (24/24), including `zero_rol_rate_zeroes_root_bonus_but_preserves_root_demand_baseline`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test root_zone_oxygenation -- --nocapture` passed (5/5).
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full `tank_core` package test suite.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation in this pass covered the `tank_core` package only; I did not rerun broader workspace packages such as `tank_harness`.
- The worktree already contained unrelated user changes in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7`, `crates/tank_core/tests/reproduction_factors.rs`, and `.ralph-burning/`; I left them untouched.
